label: Kyivan Rus
blurb: The prince's druzhyna: steady, armoured, stronger together.
lore: Kyiv in the 10th and 11th centuries: a trading power on the Dnipro, under princes like Volodymyr and Yaroslav.
Crimson shields, mail and conical helmets; a singer with the husli at the prince's side.

units.label: Druzhynnyk
units.role: Melee: advances in line, guards the archers

units.label: Strilets
units.role: Ranged: keeps distance, shoots while backing away

units.label: Huslyar
units.role: Support: songs that strengthen the army around him
